description: This file contains the CatalogContextSeed class responsible for seeding initial data into the catalog database for the eShopWeb project. It initializes default catalog brands, types, and items, and includes retry logic for transient failures.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class for seeding the catalog database with initial data, ensuring the app has default entries on startup.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Seeds the catalog database with default data if the relevant tables are empty. Includes retry logic for transient failures.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns a list of default catalog brand entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of default catalog type entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns a list of default catalog item entities.
